mapper.select: select rt.rt_no , rt.rt_days , rt.rt_shipfee , rt.rt_quantities , rt.rt_amount , rt.rt_regdate , rt.rt_payment , rt.rt_invoice , rt.rt_state , rt.rt_name , rt.rt_zipcode , rt.rt_addr , rt.rt_addrdet , rt.rt_tel , rt.rt_req , rt.rt_startdate , rt.rt_enddate , rt.rt_rtndate , rt.rt_moddate , rt.mb_id , m.mb_name , m.mb_nickname , m.mb_gender , m.mb_mail , m.mb_phone , m.mb_zipcode , m.mb_addr , m.mb_addr_detail , m.mb_grade , m.mb_state , rt.con_serial , c.con_name , c.con_platform , c.con_price , c.con_thumbnail , c.con_stock , c.con_state , rt.ttl_serial , t.ttl_name , t.ttl_genre , t.ttl_price , t.ttl_thumbnail , t.ttl_stock , t.ttl_state from tbl_rental as rt join tbl_member as m on rt.mb_id = m.mb_id left join tbl_console as c on rt.con_serial = c.con_serial left join tbl_title as t on rt.ttl_serial = t.ttl_serial where rt.mb_id = #{mb_id} order by rt.rt_regdate desc LIMIT 1
